facts.fact: ExitNodeOption means offered AND approved, rather than independent durable admin approval.
peerStatusFromNode assigns ExitNodeOption from ContainsExitRoutes(netmap node AllowedIPs).

limits: This source evidence does not prove the exact asynchronous control-plane timing or approval persistence after withdrawal.
Withdrawn recovery must not require an offered-and-approved bit before advertising; stable identity/safe prefs alone never authorize READY.
READY requires fresh actual advertised routes, online identity and true approved exit option after explicit guarded advertisement.
